reference.title: Branch, Tag, History, and Blame Actions

section.title: Show Staging
section.p: Opens the Git Staging view.

dlentry.dd: Git menu.
The main Git Client view opens so you can review, stage, commit, push, and pull changes.

section.title: Show Branches or Show Git Branch Manager View
section.p: Opens the Git Branch Manager view.

dlentry.dd: Git Staging view toolbar, Ellipsis menu, and Git menu.
The branch tree shows local and remote branches for the current repository.

section.title: Checkout
section.p: Switches the local repository to the selected branch, remote branch, tag, or commit, depending on the context.

dlentry.dd: Contextual menus in the Git Branch Manager view, the Git History view, and tag management dialog box.
The selected branch, remote branch, tag, or commit.
For a selected remote branch, the action creates a local branch from that remote branch.

section.title: Create Branch
section.p: Creates a branch from the selected branch or commit.

dlentry.dd: Contextual menus in the Git Branch Manager view and Git History view.
The selected branch or commit.
By default, a checkout is performed automatically for the new branch. Deselect Checkout branch in the Create branch dialog box if you only want to create the branch.

section.title: Track Remote Branch
section.p: Lets you select the remote branch that the local branch tracks for fetch, push, and pull commands.

dlentry.dd: Git menu, Ellipsis menu, and local branch contextual menu in the Git Branch Manager view.
The selected local branch or the current local branch.

section.title: Merge Selected Branch or Commit
section.p: Merges the selected branch or commit into the current branch.

dlentry.dd: Local branch contextual menu in the Git Branch Manager view and commit contextual menu in the Git History view.
The selected branch or commit and the current branch.
Git integrates changes that are not already in the current branch.

section.title: Squash Merge Selected Branch
section.p: Merges changes from the selected branch since it diverged from the current branch and records the result in a new commit on the current branch.

dlentry.dd: Local branch contextual menu in the Git Branch Manager view.
The selected branch and the current branch.

section.title: Show in History
section.p: Selects the commit that corresponds to the HEAD of the selected branch in the Git History view.

dlentry.dd: Local branch contextual menu in the Git Branch Manager view.
The selected branch.

section.title: Delete Branch
section.p: Deletes the selected branch.

dlentry.dd: Local branch contextual menu in the Git Branch Manager view.
The selected local branch.
You must switch to another branch before you can delete the current branch.

section.title: Show Tags
section.p: Opens a dialog box that lists all tags.

dlentry.dd: Ellipsis menu and Git menu.
You can delete tags, checkout a specific tag, or push a local-only tag to the remote repository.

section.title: Create Tag
section.p: Creates a tag on the selected commit.

dlentry.dd: Commit contextual menu in the Git History view.
The selected commit.
You can also push the tag to the remote repository.

section.title: Show History or Show Current Repository History
section.p: Opens the Git History view for the current repository, selected resource, or current file.

dlentry.dd: Git Staging view toolbar, Ellipsis menu, Git menu, Unstaged files contextual menu, and contextual Git submenus in supported views and editors.
The current repository, selected resource, or current file.

section.title: Cherry-Pick
section.p: Applies the changes from the selected commit to the current branch.

dlentry.dd: Commit contextual menu in the Git History view.
The selected commit and the current branch.

section.title: Revert Commit
section.p: Creates a commit that reverts all changes from the selected commit.

dlentry.dd: Commit contextual menu in the Git History view.
The selected commit and the current branch.
Use revert instead of reset when you need to undo a commit that was already shared.

section.title: Reset Branch to Commit
section.p: Moves the HEAD of the current branch to the selected commit.

dlentry.dd: Commit contextual menu in the Git History view.
The current branch and the selected commit.
Reset can change branch history. Use it with care, especially on branches shared with other users.

section.title: Explain Commit
section.p: Uses AI Positron to explain the changes from the selected commits.

dlentry.dd: Commit contextual menu in the Git History view.
Selected commits.

section.title: Open Previous Version
section.p: Opens the version of the selected resource from before its deletion.

dlentry.dd: Affected resources pane in the Git History view.
Available for deleted resources.

section.title: Open Working Copy Version
section.p: Opens the working copy version of the selected resource.

dlentry.dd: Affected resources pane in the Git History view.
Available for added and modified resources. It also works if the resource was renamed between versions.

section.title: Reset File to This Commit
section.p: Performs a checkout of the selected version of the resource and overwrites its current version.

dlentry.dd: Affected resources pane in the Git History view.
Available for added and modified resources. It does not work if the resource was renamed or deleted between versions.
This action overwrites the current working copy version of the selected file.

section.title: Compare with Previous Version
section.p: Compares the selected version of the resource with the previous version.

dlentry.dd: Affected resources pane in the Git History view.
Available for modified resources.

section.title: Compare with Working Copy Version
section.p: Compares the selected version of the resource with the current working copy version.

dlentry.dd: Affected resources pane in the Git History view.
Available for modified resources.

section.title: Compare with Each Other
section.p: Compares two selected versions of a single file with each other.

dlentry.dd: Affected resources pane in the Git History view.
Available when selecting two versions of a single file.

section.title: Show Blame
section.p: Opens the selected resource in the main editing area and colors editor lines based on revision information.

dlentry.dd: Unstaged files contextual menu, current editor contextual menu, and Git submenu in the Project or DITA Maps Manager view.
The selected resource or current editor file.
When you select a line in the editor, the corresponding entry is highlighted in the history table in the Git History view.
